jobs.title: Budgeting Financial Analyst (3509)
jobs.description:
**Job Accountabilities:**



* Prepare several reports for budget preparation (Historical reports \& Peers)


* Following up on the data collection process within time frames.


* Assists with projecting future financial needs and collaborates with budget manager and other management personnel to prepare long\-term financial plans, and other budget and financial reports.


* Prepare budget analysis and recommendations to upper\-level management at the beginning of each budgetary cycle.


* Prepare departmental expenditures status in comparison to original budget.


* Assist in preparing budgeting status reports for committees and stakeholders
* Assist in preparing high\-quality dashboards and PowerPoint presentations to be presented to our board members and senior management to be approved from their side.


* Periodical reporting of Budgeting insights to relevant Business stakeholders


* Follow all relevant approved department’s policies, and procedures and monitor adherence so that work is carried out in a controlled manner.


* Follow the day\-to\-day operations related to own jobs in the department to ensure continuity of work.


* Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal EG Bank policies and code of conduct to maintain EG Bank’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks.



**Qualifications and Experience:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Finance \& Accounting or a related field. \-related certifications are considered an asset
* 2 or 3 years of experience in Finance Field, Preferred exposure in Budget \& performance
* Experience within Banking Industry will be considered as an asset


**Skills:**


* Excellent command of English and Arabic languages (written and spoken)
* Excellent communication skills

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager

**Positions Available : Portfolio Manager(Off\-Plan)**

We are looking for **Immediate Joiners** who have **atleast 6 months of real estate experiance**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make outbound calls to potential clients from the provided leads database.
* Answer incoming calls and respond to customer inquiries regarding property listings.
* Explain property features, pricing, and availability to prospective buyers or tenants.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and client interactions in the CRM system.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with clients to encourage repeat business.
* Provide updates on promotional campaigns and new project launches.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly call and conversion targets.

**What We Offer**

At Housing Roofs, we provide our agents with the resources, and support required to build a successful real estate career

* Competitive commission structure
* Qualified leads and fresh databases
* Exclusive properties and listings
* Strong developer relationships and access to off\-plan projects
* Marketing and lead\-generation support
* Professional sales training and ongoing mentorship
* Social media and personal branding support
* Residency visa sponsorship
* Supportive and professional working environment
* Opportunities to grow within the company

**Requirements:**

* Currently based in UAE.
* Motivated, ambitious, and target\-driven
* Confident in client communication and negotiations
* Strong in lead conversion and closing
* Professional in appearance and communication
* Able to work independently while being part of a team
* Committed to building a long\-term career in real estate
* Real estate sales experience is required.

**Application**

If you are an experienced real estate professional looking for the right platform, resources, and environment to grow your business, we would like to hear from you.

Send us your updated CV **hr@housingroofs.com** / **Whatsapp :\+971556603625** and our recruitment team will contact shortlisted candidates.
